name: Armor of Law (Prayer)
body:
The gods of law protect you against a single blow.

Prerequisites: Worshiping a deity with the Law Domain, Lawful alignment

Benefit: Against a single blow a day, you gain damage reduction (1/2 your character level)/Law.

You may decide to use this after a successful attack roll but before damage is rolled.
